issue_failure_class_map — all 5 Industry issues (SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE, AUTOMATION_FAILURE, TOXIC_SPILL, QUALITY_CRISIS, WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE) grounded in each issue's OWN canonical circuit detail and/or summary/_authored text (quoted per issue).

heterogeneity_flagged: TOXIC_SPILL uses EXCITOTOXICITY (excess drive + failed clearance -> toxic overload) — a clearance-failure archetype that the Finance overlay never invoked. The industrial waste/containment stream (ENS overwhelmed, discharge to environment) is a near-textbook match to the TERMINATION_CLEARANCE invariant ('a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic'). THIS IS A KEY FINDING: Industry exercises a failure archetype (clearance/toxicity) that Finance did not.

Industry carries BOTH gating subtypes: SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE = GATING_FAILURE gate-stuck-CLOSED -> starvation (like Finance BANKING_CRISIS/CREDIT_FREEZE), and QUALITY_CRISIS = GATING_FAILURE gate-fails-OPEN / under-filtering -> defect escape (the too-little-filtering flooding flavor Finance never used).

Industry has ZERO UNMAPPED issues (5/5 grounded). Every Industry failure is a physical/dynamical process failure with a dynamical analog among the 9 classes; there is no deception/information-integrity archetype like Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL. AUTOMATION_FAILURE names a 'cyberattack' vector (adversarial) as one of several causes, but its governing mechanism cue is dynamical (brake-loss), so it stays mapped.

WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE is the borderline case: its underlying driver is RESOURCE/INPUT DEPLETION (skilled-labor deficit) — a partly NON-DYNAMICAL failure that could be argued UNMAPPED. It is kept mapped to DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS because its _authored circuit shows exactly the class signature: loss of a shared input disables multiple distant connected production nodes (M1, SMA, dACC all hypo-active together). Divergence with the pure resource-depletion reading is recorded per issue.

AUTOMATION_FAILURE — its CANONICAL single-node cue STN[Hypo] 'no-brake=runaway' names DISINHIBITION, but its _authored circuit narrative describes automated systems CEASING/halting (a loss-of-executor flavor). Node-cue-vs-authored divergence recorded, classed on the canonical brake-loss cue.

TOXIC_SPILL — its CANONICAL single-node cue HYPO[Hyper] 'homeostatic set-point — severed=runaway' independently supports DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (loss of the regulator). Classed EXCITOTOXICITY on the stronger summary/_authored clearance-failure grounding; node-cue divergence recorded.
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Industry-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Industry issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or summary and/or _authored circuit detail, quoted in industry_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where a node cue and the summary/_authored narrative diverge, the divergence is recorded rather than resolved by guessing.

SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.industry_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; _authored THAL[Hypo-active]: "Supply chain routing and coordination breaks down as material flows from multiple supplier tiers are simultaneously disrupted"; summary: "Cascading failure across the supplier network ... resulting in production halts"
SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.reasoning: The named mechanism is the routing GATE stuck closed: THAL is the gating relay, and the canonical cue verbatim is 'stuck-closed=starvation'. A gate stuck closed that starves the downstream (production halts) is the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation). This is the cleanest grounding of the set.
SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.note: Summary also carries a secondary cascade element ('Cascading failure across the supplier network'), which straddles DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS; classed on the primary node cue (routing gate stuck-closed), which is the dominant named mechanism.

AUTOMATION_FAILURE.subtype: brake-fail -> no-brake runaway (loss of the stop/hold)
AUTOMATION_FAILURE.industry_text: canonical circuit STN[Hypo]: "hyperdirect brake / hold — no-brake=runaway"; _authored CBLM[Hypo-active]: "Robotic systems cease precise coordinated operation as control software or hardware fails"; summary: "Widespread failure of robotic and automated production systems due to software bugs, firmware corruption, cyberattack, or control system hardware failure"
AUTOMATION_FAILURE.reasoning: The canonical mechanism cue is explicitly the loss of the hyperdirect BRAKE/HOLD ('no-brake=runaway') with STN hypo-active. Losing the inhibitor/hold and releasing runaway is the DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Classed on the verbatim canonical brake-loss cue.
AUTOMATION_FAILURE.note: DIVERGENCE recorded: the _authored circuit and summary describe automated systems CEASING/halting (CBLM, FPN hypo-active; M1 to degraded manual mode) — a loss-of-executor flavor rather than a released-runaway. The summary also lists 'cyberattack' as one cause (an adversarial vector with no dynamical analog), but the governing named cue is the STN brake-loss, so the issue stays mapped to DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME.

TOXIC_SPILL.subtype: excess drive + failed clearance -> toxic overload / discharge
TOXIC_SPILL.industry_text: canonical circuit HYPO[Hyper]: "homeostatic set-point — severed=runaway"; _authored HYPO[Hyper-active]: "Chemical process systems enter uncontrolled reaction or release state as containment is breached"; _authored ENS[Hyper-active]: "Waste treatment and containment systems are overwhelmed as spill volume exceeds designed capacity, allowing environmental discharge"; summary: "Uncontrolled release of hazardous chemicals ... causing environmental contamination"
TOXIC_SPILL.reasoning: The failure is excessive chemical drive (uncontrolled reaction/release) combined with FAILED CLEARANCE (waste treatment/containment overwhelmed, exceeds designed capacity, discharge to environment). That is the EXCITOTOXICITY archetype (excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> toxic overload), and it directly instantiates the TERMINATION_CLEARANCE invariant ('a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic'). Strongest grounding is the clearance-failure signature at ENS plus the literal toxicity.
TOXIC_SPILL.note: DIVERGENCE recorded: the canonical HYPO node cue ('homeostatic set-point — severed=runaway') independently supports DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (severing the homeostatic regulator releases runaway). Classed EXCITOTOXICITY on the stronger summary/_authored clearance-failure + toxicity grounding. This is the KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING vs Finance, which never invoked EXCITOTOXICITY.

QUALITY_CRISIS.industry_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hypo]: "conflict/error monitor — noise-chase"; _authored dACC[Hypo-active]: "Quality control monitoring failed to detect the systematic defect, indicating a fundamental gap in inspection coverage or statistical sampling adequacy"; summary: "Discovery of widespread product defects affecting multiple production lots"
QUALITY_CRISIS.reasoning: dACC (the error/conflict monitor) is hypo-active and 'failed to detect the systematic defect' due to a 'gap in inspection coverage'. An error monitor / quality gate that fails to filter lets defects pass downstream = GATING_FAILURE in its too-little-filtering / wrong-information-passed sense (the inverse subtype of SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE). The defects escaping to the field is exactly 'wrong information passed' by an under-performing gate.
QUALITY_CRISIS.note: This is the OPEN-gate subtype (under-filtering -> defect escape), contrasted with SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE's CLOSED-gate subtype (starvation). Industry thus exercises both gating subtypes; Finance used only the closed/starvation subtype.

WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE.subtype: lost shared input -> distributed hypofunction cascade across connected nodes
WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE.industry_text: canonical circuit M1[Hypo]: "primary motor cortex — motor output — weakness, paresis"; _authored dlPFC/M1/dACC/SMA all Hypo-active: "Assembly line throughput drops as understaffed stations create bottlenecks"; "Heavy equipment utilization drops as insufficient qualified operators leave machines idle"; "Quality control suffers as overworked inspectors miss defects"; summary: "Severe deficit of skilled industrial workers ... preventing facilities from operating at capacity"
WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE.reasoning: Loss of a shared INPUT (skilled labor) disables multiple distant connected production nodes at once: the _authored circuit shows dlPFC, M1, SMA and dACC all going hypo-active together. That is the DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS signature ('losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure'). The M1 'weakness, paresis' cue is the loss-of-drive deficit at the output node.
WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE.note: BORDERLINE / DIVERGENCE recorded: the root driver is RESOURCE/INPUT DEPLETION (a labor-supply shortage), which is a partly NON-DYNAMICAL failure and could be argued UNMAPPED. It is kept mapped because the loss-of-input-cascades-across-the-network signature matches the class definition and is visible in the multi-node hypo cascade. This is Industry's closest analog to a heterogeneity flag, though (unlike Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL) it still admits a grounded dynamical class.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against industry.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses the _authored node list).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS (5/5). Every authored circuit includes at least one regulatory/feedback node; none is a bare excitatory driver without its brake. Same headline result as Energy (6/6) and Finance (6/6). HETEROGENEITY vs Finance: of the 5 CANONICAL single-node circuits, THREE (STN, HYPO, dACC) are THEMSELVES regulatory nodes and would PASS even canonical-only; only TWO (THAL for SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE, M1 for WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE) are non-regulatory and would fail in isolation (in Finance, BOTH flagged canonical singletons, BLA and CeA, were non-regulatory).

SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] alone (a gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies HIPP (homeostatic feedback / memory index) and dlPFC (executive).

AUTOMATION_FAILURE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is STN[Hypo] alone; STN IS in REGULATORY_NODES, so this issue would PASS even canonical-only. _authored additionally supplies CBLM (forward-model error-correct), dACC (conflict monitor) and dlPFC (executive).

TOXIC_SPILL.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is HYPO[Hyper] alone; HYPO IS in REGULATORY_NODES, so this issue would PASS even canonical-only. _authored additionally supplies OFC (outcome valuation).

QUALITY_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is dACC[Hypo] alone; dACC IS in REGULATORY_NODES, so this issue would PASS even canonical-only. _authored additionally supplies OFC (valuation/standards).

WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is M1[Hypo] alone (primary motor cortex, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies dlPFC, dACC and CBLM.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Industry mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action (line cycle time, machine actuation) / slow-governance (capex, workforce training, standards revision) separation, or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
